title: Fates Cobblemon Server!
description: This modpack was created for the Fates Cobblemon private server, but it is fully functional for anyone who wants to enjoy a custom Cobblemon experience in their own single-player worlds!
body:
Welcome to our ultimate Cobblemon adventure! This modpack is carefully crafted for a seamless Pokémon experience within Minecraft. We’ve combined the massive world of Cobblemon with essential quality-of-life mods to make catching 'em all more fun than ever.
Key Features:
Explore & Catch: Hundreds of Pokémon to find across diverse biomes.
Better Navigation: Includes Xaero’s Minimap and CobbleNav so you never get lost on your journey.
Optimised for Play: Built with performance mods to ensure smooth gameplay, even on lower-end PCs.
Custom UI: A polished look with FancyMenu and custom interfaces for a true RPG feel.
Whether you're battling friends in the arena or building the perfect ranch, this pack is all about having fun and starting your own story!
